  "notes": "The evidence paper faithfully carries forward the concrete factual content of the SHCP Comunicado No. 9 (30 January 2023) for AMLO's Mexico 2022. Every quantitative claim in the paper — total public spending (7.569 trillion pesos, +4.1% real, 26.5% of GDP), social protection (+8.7%, 5.3% of GDP), physical investment (+25.2%, 3.3% of GDP), public revenues (6.595 trillion pesos, +422 bn vs. program), public debt (49.4% of GDP), fiscal aggregates (primary balance –0.5%, public deficit –3.4%, RFSP 4.4%), fiscal buffers (USD 262 bn), tax revenue ex-IEPS-fuel (13.6% of GDP), ISR (2.270 trillion pesos, 8.0% of GDP), IVA (1.222 trillion pesos, 4.3% of GDP), oil revenues (1.482 trillion pesos, 5.2% of GDP), IEPS-fuel subsidy (397 bn pesos foregone), GDP growth (2.9% through November), unemployment (2.8% total / 2.5% women), formal jobs (753,000 IMSS, sexenio 1.3 million vs. Calderón/Fox), private consumption (+7.1% through Oct), gross fixed investment (+5.5%, machinery +12.2%), real wage (+2.7%), FDI (USD 32 bn through Q3, USD 14 bn new investments), trade (USD 1.2 trillion), and the dated debt-market operations (7 Oct 2022, 30 Nov 2022, 7 Dec 2022, 8 Dec 2022) with exact peso amounts — appears in the original HTML units. Locator labels (introducción, executive-summary block, macroeconomic block, tax-revenue block, executive-summary block, debt-market block, labor-market block, trade/FDI block, closing paragraph) correctly map to the canonical paragraph ordering of the single short press release. Where the source is silent on a 5B dimension (legislative agenda specifics, personnel appointments, regulatory reform texts, audit/court cooperation, program-level execution quality, distributional/Gini/regional breakdowns, ex-post correction narratives), the paper explicitly flags the absence rather than fabricating content — these are real source limitations of a quarterly executive press release, not paper omissions. The paper separates the SHCP's own executive framing ('bienestar de las familias mexicanas,' 'manejo responsable,' RFSP/deficit as percentages of GDP) from measured outcomes, preserving the self-report nature of the artifact. Attribution to SHCP and the gob.mx URL are preserved. The paper does not resemble an abstract, back-cover summary, or table of contents; it preserves the source's question-relevant factual payload in a structure that lets the judge reason over claims without reopening the original."
}
